theme_strategy: Valuevade Dual / Brand Reference Mode (Light Canvas #F5ECFF & Deep Navy #02073D)
context_type: Hybrid Fullstack Finance Learning Platform & AI Terminal

typography.h1_hero: 38px mobile / 64px desktop, weight 700, line-height 1.06, zero letter-spacing
typography.h2_section: Outfit, weight 600, zero letter-spacing; preserve page hierarchy

layout_and_spacing.padding_system: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16)
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Unframed sections with generous padding; individual cards use 8px radii
layout_and_spacing.grid_mode: Reference-inspired full-width editorial bands and original finance diagrams; dense functional editors preserved
layout_and_spacing.header: Glassmorphic header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F5ECFF]/80 or bg-[#0A0D28]/80 with border-b border-[#5B5F8F]/15 z-50 sticky top-0

hero_section.tagline: A new way of mastering finance in the age of AI
hero_section.headline: A new way of mastering finance in the age of AI.
hero_section.hero_graphics: Original annual-report / AI / price-chart illustration extracted from the supplied PDF, followed by interactive product previews explicitly labeled illustrative data. No live stock ticker integration.

key_sections.title: Finance Career Lies vs AI Realities
key_sections.graphic_style: Comparison Bento cards with vibrant violet and pink pill tags, contrasting common myths against actionable financial skill modules.

key_sections.title: Equities & ER Roadmap Carousel
key_sections.graphic_style: Step-by-step interactive timeline with emerald green completion nodes (#0F9D78) and blue connection lines.

key_sections.title: AI Mock Interview & Spreadsheet Terminal
key_sections.graphic_style: Dark/Light hybrid glassmorphic panel with active code/financial model terminal, real-time response gauge, and downloadable Excel/Claude prompt templates.

inner_page_graphic_treatments.courses_and_catalog: Clean white cards over soft lavender background (#F5ECFF), colorful category pills (#246BFD, #6A5CFF, #FF6AC1), progress indicators, and instructor badge cards.
inner_page_graphic_treatments.ai_mock_interviews: Split-pane layout with AI voice waveform simulation, prompt helper sidebar, and instant feedback scorecards using #0F9D78 (Green) and #246BFD (Blue).
inner_page_graphic_treatments.spreadsheet_simulations: High-density data view with dark blue accents, active cell highlights, live calculations, and step-by-step guided instructions.
inner_page_graphic_treatments.dashboard_and_admin: Cardless or soft-bordered dense analytics grid with clean metric callouts, progress rings, and test status indicators.

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements (buttons, inputs, links, cards, tabs, score displays) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="start-learning-button", data-testid="course-card-equity-research").
general_ui_ux_guidelines.file_extension: Target implementation files use standard .js / .jsx formats.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure high text contrast. Never use plain white text on transparent backgrounds or pure white text on light lavender. Use #02073D for high readability.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.micro_interactions: Subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1), active press scale (scale-95), and ring focus indicators.
